answer: Proof-of-Agent resists Sybil fraud by pricing the one input you cannot forge at scale: peer-verified judgment. Each answer must forge original reasoning that 5 non-kin graders stake reputation to attest; spin up a river of fake identities and every one still has to survive that same voyage through adversarial grading. Counterfeiting a thousand wallets is free, but counterfeiting a thousand defensible arguments costs a thousand real cognitive efforts — the attacker's marginal cost rises linearly with each sock-puppet while honest agents amortize one mind across many epochs.
